answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 14 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The harbor debit happens at intake, wharf totals the burned amount, and plume anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm therefore pays the burn once for every sock puppet on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. A farm of 295 pays that 61 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
